content.text: Ayush Counselling in Maharashtra is conducted for admission to the AYUSH courses: BAMS/BNYS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS after the NEET-UG examination. The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell (MAHACET) is responsible for the Maharashtra Ayush Counselling. State-domicile students and non-resident students can participate in the counselling through different quotas, such as the State Quota and All India Quota(AIQ), respectively.
NEET-UG 2025 was held on 4 May 2025, and the results were published on 14 June 2025. The Maharashtra Ayush Counselling dates are yet to be announced officially.
This article will provide everything you need to know about the Maharashtra Ayush Counselling 2025, including important dates, fees, eligibility, registration details, and counselling process.

sections.heading: Ayush Counselling in Maharashtra

content.text: The Maharashtra Ayush Counselling official website is https://cetcell.mahacet.org/ , which updates and releases all the notifications, publications, and results regarding the counselling. Ayurveda, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha & Homeopathy seats are offered in the state quota and All India Quota in the counselling. The state quota seats, which are 85%, are reserved for the domicile students of Maharashtra. The All India quota, which constitutes 15% of seats, is generally open to non-domicile students or students from all other states and Union territories.

The state quota offers seats in government and private Ayush colleges in Maharashtra through the Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell, and the All India Quota seats counselling is conducted by the AYUSH Admissions Central Counselling Committee (AACCC) for the government and private Ayush colleges in Maharashtra. The BHMS, BUMS, BSMS, BNYS, and BAMS colleges in Maharashtra , participating in the counselling, are recognized by the NCISM, NCH, and the Ministry of Ayush
The Maharashtra Ayush Counselling 2025 dates are expected to be announced after the publication of NEET-UG 2025 results.

sections.heading: Maharashtra Ayush Counselling Eligibility Criteria

content.text: The following are the requisites to be met by the candidates to be eligible for admission to AYUSH courses in Maharashtra.

items: An Indian Citizen/ Non-Resident Indians (NRI)/ Overseas Citizens of India (OCI)/ Outside Maharashtra candidate (OMS) who qualified NEET-UG examination. (For Institutional Quota)
Domicile of Maharashtra who qualified NEET (For State Quota)
The candidates must attain 17 years of age on or before December of the year of admission.
The candidates must pass the higher secondary/12/HSC/ or Equivalent examination from a recognized board/state-recognized board. ( For Domicile Candidates)

The candidates must score at least 50% of aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in the higher secondary examination (For UR/EWS Candidates) and at least 40% of aggregate marks (For Reserved Category)

content.text: Registered candidates can fill in their preferences for colleges during this round. It is mandatory to lock the choices before the deadline to proceed to the further rounds. The rule for choice filling differs in each allotment round.

items: Document Verification

content.text: The candidates allotted need to attend the document verification process at the designated centers. Carry the original documents and certificates for verification and collect the verification slip.

items: Reporting to the College

content.text: The candidates who wish to join the allotted college should report to the respective college on the scheduled date and produce the original certificates and documents to them.
